label: Site catalog
purpose: What each page of the client's site sells, so sessions can be read by the product type, collection, or price band of the page they landed on.
data: One row per URL path of the storefront, from the store's catalog export: the product type, collection, and price band of the product or collection at that path.

product_type.label: Landing product type
product_type.data: The product type of the landing path in the site catalog; (unmatched) when the catalog does not list the path.

collection.label: Landing collection
collection.data: The collection of the landing path in the site catalog; (unmatched) when the catalog does not list the path.

price_band.label: Landing price band
price_band.data: The price band of the landing path in the site catalog; (unmatched) when the catalog does not list the path.
